Calculator.whyTitle: Why a country or service may be unavailable:

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.s1P1: Lanka Post Directory is an independent, community-maintained directory of post offices, postal codes, and postage rates across Sri Lanka. It is not affiliated with, operated by, or endorsed by the Department of Posts (Sri Lanka Post).
Privacy.s1P2: You can browse the directory, look up postal codes, read postal guides, and use the postage calculator without creating an account or providing personal information.
Privacy.s2Item1Body: If you choose to register as a contributor, we store your name, email address, hashed password, and optional two-factor authentication settings solely to authenticate your account and attribute community contributions.
Privacy.s2Item2Body: Suggested edits to post office details, user reviews, and community-uploaded photos are stored for moderation and public display on the relevant post office listing.
Privacy.s2Item3Body: Standard technical request metadata (such as IP address, browser user-agent, and timestamps) may be processed temporarily by our hosting infrastructure and rate-limiting systems to prevent spam and abuse.
Privacy.s3P1: We use Google AdSense to help support the hosting and maintenance of this free directory. Third-party vendors, including Google, use cookies to serve ads based on a user's prior visits to this website or other websites.
Privacy.s3P2: Google's use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads to you based on your visit to Lanka Post Directory and/or other sites on the Internet.
Privacy.s3OptOutPrefix: You may opt out of personalized advertising by visiting
Privacy.s3OptOutMid: . Alternatively, you can opt out of a third-party vendor's use of cookies for personalized advertising by visiting
Privacy.s4P1: We use Google Analytics to collect aggregated usage insights (such as page views, search interactions, and general device/browser statistics) so we can understand which directory features and postal guides are most helpful and improve site reliability.
Privacy.s5Prefix: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, or would like to request correction or deletion of your contributor account or submitted content, please open an issue on our
